summary: Explains that the Tao of the IETF, previously published as a series of RFCs, is instead to be published as a web page. It also sets out the procedure for publishing and editing that page. It is informational. It was replaced by RFC 9592.

eli5.summary: A guidebook for newcomers used to be printed again and again. This memo says to keep it on a website that can be fixed anytime, and explains who may fix it.

questions: where is the tao of the ietf published
how is the tao of the ietf edited
